§dPurpose and mechanism§r
Keep one Spacetime Singularity Calibration Engineering controller in your inventory to complete this check without consuming it. This attraction device opens the route to Prosperity and runs no recipes. With a valid structure, maintenance, and all covered chunks loaded, it preheats for §1600§r ticks (§130§r seconds) at §130,720§r EU/t, then draws §115,360§r EU/t continuously. Every energy hatch must accept at least §132,768§r EU/t. Touching the active core teleports the player immediately.

§cImportant precautions§r
Provide adequate energy-input capacity and sustained power before checking maintenance and covered-chunk loading. Controller possession completes this goal without operation or travel. Before actually entering Prosperity, mark and charge the return beacon. Touching the active core teleports immediately, so treat access to it as part of the travel procedure.
